name: patient_has_undergone_ct_of_abdomen_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a computed tomography (CT) of the abdomen.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a computed tomography (CT) of the abdomen.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a computed tomography (CT) of the abdomen.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a computed tomography (CT) of the abdomen.

name: patient_has_undergone_ct_of_abdomen_inthehistory@@referral_from_emergency_department
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's abdomen CT was referred from the Emergency Department.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's abdomen CT was referred from the Emergency Department.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's abdomen CT was not referred from the Emergency Department.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the referral for the patient's abdomen CT was from the Emergency Department.

name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kg_per_m2
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kilograms per square meter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such BMI measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kilograms per square meter is available.

name: intravenous_contrast_enhancement_is_contraindicated_for_patient
meaning: Boolean indicating whether intravenous contrast enhancement is contraindicated for the patient.
when_true: Set to true if intravenous contrast enhancement is contraindicated for the patient.
when_false: Set to false if intravenous contrast enhancement is not contraindicated for the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether intravenous contrast enhancement is contraindicated for the patient.
